### 💡 Type of Change

Select one or more that apply:

### ✅ Checklist Before Submission

Please confirm the following before submitting:

* [ ] Code follows the style guidelines described in [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md)
* [ ] Code has been tested locally
* [ ] Existing tests pass successfully
* [ ] New tests were added (if applicable)
* [ ] Documentation was updated (README, examples, or `docs/`)
* [ ] No sensitive data (API keys, paths, credentials) are included
* [ ] Commits are descriptive and atomic
